name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for interior framing?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for interior framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for interior framing, look for experience with similar projects, proper licensing and insurance, and a strong track record demonstrated by references and reviews. Ensure they clearly communicate the process, timeline, and cost. A good contractor should also be knowledgeable about local building codes in your specific area, such as San Mateo County or San Francisco County. Request detailed bids and compare them not just on price, but also on scope of work, materials, and proposed schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience, proper licensing, insurance, clear communication, and local code knowledge.
